name: publish_artifact
description: Publish an artifact, or a new version when `id` is given. Pass `content` (one file, with `format`) or `files` (path → text, or { base64 } for binary, or { uploadId } from create_upload) plus `entry`. Inline payloads are limited to 2 MB. Returns id, version and view URL.

name: create_upload
description: Get a signed URL to PUT one large file (over 2 MB, up to 25 MB), then pass its uploadId in publish_artifact `files`. Omit artifactId to reserve a new artifact id.

name: get_artifact
description: Read an artifact's metadata and one version (latest by default). Returns a file's text inline when it is text and at most 1 MB; otherwise a short-lived downloadUrl.

name: list_artifacts
description: List artifacts you can see, newest first. Filter by scope, format, visibility, owner, agent or updatedSince; page with cursor.

name: search_artifacts
description: Full-text search artifact titles, descriptions and content. Returns matches with snippets; page with cursor.

name: list_versions
description: List an artifact's versions, newest first.

name: restore_version
description: Restore an earlier version by publishing a copy of it as the new latest version.

name: share_artifact
description: Share an artifact with an email address as viewer or editor. Owner only.

name: unshare_artifact
description: Remove an email address's share. Owner only.

name: set_visibility
description: Set who can open an artifact: private (you and shares), team (all members) or public (anyone with the link). Owner only.

name: delete_artifact
description: Delete an artifact. It can be restored from the dashboard for 30 days. Owner only.

name: artifact_data_get
description: Read one document from an artifact's live-page data collection.

name: artifact_data_list
description: List documents in an artifact's live-page data collection; page with cursor.

name: artifact_data_query
description: Query an artifact's live-page data collection with equality `where`, `orderBy`, `order` and `limit`.

name: artifact_data_set
description: Create or replace a document in an artifact's live-page data collection. Requires editor access.

name: artifact_data_update
description: Merge top-level fields into a document in an artifact's live-page data collection. Requires editor access.

name: artifact_data_delete
description: Delete a document from an artifact's live-page data collection. Requires editor access.
